name: Rocko's Modern Taphouse
notes: 4 photos; two were draft beer/wine tap boards (skipped, drink-only) and one was a handwritten spritz-special sign (not a food menu). One photo (2.jpg) was the printed food menu with burgers, shareables, and salad.

dishes.name: Burger
dishes.description: All burgers come doggy style (lettuce, tomato, onion, pickle, mustard, mayo). Choose your protein: beef or beyond. Comes with a side of fries or tots.

dishes.name: Chicken Strips
dishes.description: 5 strips served with choice of ranch, BBQ, or honey mustard

dishes.name: Tater Skins
dishes.description: 4 pieces, served with sour cream or ranch, cheese, bacon, and chives

dishes.name: Tots
dishes.description: Served with choice of ranch, BBQ, ketchup, mayo, or mustard

dishes.name: Chicken Salad
dishes.description: Choice of grilled or fried chicken, romaine lettuce, bacon, shredded cheese, onion, and tomato, bleu cheese or ranch dressing
